promos.hook_description: A medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely and screaming 'Silence! Silence!' while raising the branding poker.
promos.cliffhanger_description: An extreme close-up of Juliana's wide eye with the glowing orange branding iron inches from her cornea right before the cut to black.
promos.post_rationale: We start with pure chaos and a branding iron inches from an eyeball because nothing stops a thumb mid-scroll faster than immediate terror.

promos.hook_description: A macro close-up of a massive blackthorn needle stabbing deep into Juliana's bleeding hand accompanied by a sickening crunch.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Macro close-up holding on Juliana's bloodied fist firmly gripping the emerald ring against the frozen ground as it cuts to black.
promos.post_rationale: Following up the first hit with a disgusting needle crunch keeps people hooked on the sheer shock value before they even know who the characters are.

promos.hook_description: Massive wooden cathedral doors slam open violently, revealing a bishop and armed crown officer stepping through mist and blinding light.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Catherine's despair morphs into a cold, venomous, triumphant smile as she watches her rival's wedding claim get dismantled.
promos.post_rationale: People love a dramatic church interruption, and this brings a nice change of pace from pure violence into courtroom-style drama.

promos.hook_description: Catherine completely losing control with an enraged scream, followed by a red-hot poker burning into a book.
promos.cliffhanger_description: An extreme macro close-up of Juliana's trembling eye reflecting the brilliant orange ember of the hot poker inches from her face.
promos.post_rationale: It's similar in flavor to our first post, but shifting to a book burning keeps the villain unhinged and the audience sweating.

promos.hook_description: A tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by firelight delivering the chilling line 'Then call it witchcraft.'
promos.cliffhanger_description: An extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's cold eyes as he delivers the final line: 'Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.'
promos.post_rationale: Now that folks are invested, we drop this longer, sixty-second spooky scene about witchcraft to deepen the plot.

promos.hook_description: A close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze as he delivers the line 'Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.'
promos.cliffhanger_description: The mother's soundless gasp of sheer dread as the scene holds on her horror and the orchestral score cuts to silence.
promos.post_rationale: Time for a classic plot twist revelation about someone coming back from the dead to shake up the viewers.

promos.hook_description: A camera tracking down to a distinctive engraved signet ring on Juliana's finger accompanied by a sharp gasp sound effect.
promos.cliffhanger_description: The Dowager Duchess tightly clasps Juliana's hand holding the signet ring as an orchestral chord cuts to black.
promos.post_rationale: This ring reveal gives viewers a satisfying puzzle piece about secret identities halfway through our run.

promos.hook_description: Juliana screaming desperately 'Barbara, don't!' as the book is violently snatched.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana and her new husband walking away through the iron gates into the rain as the scene fades out.
promos.post_rationale: A longer emotional clip about getting married and walking away in the rain gives people a breather from all the screaming.

promos.hook_description: The Blond Nobleman's expression freezing into a dark, dangerous scowl as he whispers the word 'poison'.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as the deadly trap closes around her and the screen cuts to black.
promos.post_rationale: A false accusation of poison brings back that urgent, sweaty-palms feeling right when people might get too comfortable.

promos.hook_description: The Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space and snarling a venomous threat.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Close-up of Juliana looking up with wide eyes as a tense low dramatic cello swell holds into an abrupt cut.
promos.post_rationale: A street thug cornering our main character is an easy narrative trap that makes viewers root for a rescue.

promos.hook_description: A close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron as she is called a servant.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Gerald furiously lunging forward and asking 'And your husband?'
promos.post_rationale: Muddy hands and servant insults lean heavily into the underdog trope that short-form fans eat up.

promos.hook_description: Catherine aggressively yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Catherine gleefully declares that the book of weeds will hang Juliana before the magistrate.
promos.post_rationale: Stealing a locket is petty villainy at its finest and reminds everyone why they hate Catherine.

promos.hook_description: Gerald's face contorting in pure rage as he shouts about a penniless nobody.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana and the warrior walking hand-in-hand through open doors into the bright sunlight.
promos.post_rationale: Walking hand-in-hand into the sunlight gives viewers a nice ray of hope after all the doom and gloom.

promos.hook_description: Juliana looking unblinkingly at Catherine and cold-heartedly commanding 'As a scullery maid.'
promos.cliffhanger_description: Catherine prostrating herself entirely upon the floor before Alexander and Juliana as the scene cuts to black.
promos.post_rationale: Seeing the bad guy finally bow down on the floor is the ultimate revenge payback that keeps fans cheering.

promos.hook_description: A full shot of Juliana standing tall, transforming her posture into regal composure before the guests.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana holding her head high with steady resolve as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.
promos.post_rationale: We wrap up our schedule with a classy, calm posture shift that shows she owns the room now.

overall_strategy: We hook people right away with loud screams, dangerous weapons, and nasty villains so they stop scrolling. Once they are hooked, we mix in some mystery, romance, and plot twists so they do not get bored. Finally, we end on sweet revenge moments to make them feel good and click to watch the whole show.
